answer_1.quote: When presented with a user query, tool-augmented LLMs can determine when and how to utilize specific tools to generate more accurate and informative responses. For example, tools can enable LLMs to use a calculator, set calendar events, and access real-time weather information.
answer_1.outputs: Function calls (e.g., API invocations) and responses incorporating tool outputs

answer_2.quote: We quantify the retrieval performance using Recall@K and NDCG@K, with K = {1, 3, 5} following. Recall@K measures the proportion of cases where the positive tool appears in the top-K results, while NDCG@K also considers its ranking position within the top-K.
